name: nexus_get_collection_revision
description:
Get a specific collection revision (mod count, sizes, status) via v2 GraphQL [v2 - no v1 quota].

Returns:
    JSON {id, revisionNumber, revisionStatus, status, adultContent, latest,
    overallRating, totalDownloads, uniqueDownloads, modCount, totalSize,
    collection}.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

revision.description: Revision number. Omit for the latest revision.
revision.title: Revision

view_adult_content.description: Set true to inspect adult collections.
view_adult_content.title: View Adult Content
